name: Kristen-Erin Balderaz
background: Kristen-Erin Balderaz lives in Cheyenne, Laramie County. She withdrew from the 2026 House District 61 race after a move. Her campaign website asked supporters who would have voted for her to write in Meg Varhalmi instead, to keep a Democrat on the November ballot (already recorded in the 2026 research store).

The Wyoming Tribune Eagle published a House District 61 candidate page for her on Sept. 30, 2026, and recorded that no questionnaire was received. By the time of this fill, her campaign site (ke4wyo.com) said the website was winding down and no longer carried a biographical profile.
No public occupation, education, or military record was found in the sources reviewed for this fill.
